hunks.baseline: Long before the countless government and Murim forces appeared, hundreds of banners flying in the wind, the people of Xining City were already bursting with excitement at the news of reinforcements.
hunks.sol: Long before the countless government and Murim forces appeared beneath hundreds of flying banners, the people of Xining City were already bursting with excitement at the news of reinforcements.

hunks.baseline: That alone was unprecedented in the history of the continent. But the people gathered under those banners were just as extraordinary.
hunks.sol: That alone was unprecedented in the history of the continent. And the people gathered under those banners were just as extraordinary.

hunks.baseline: “I-I heard the Silver Flash Spear Hero and the Taebaek Divine Elder have joined them, too.”
hunks.sol: “I-I heard the Silver Flash Spear and the Taebaek Divine Elder have joined them, too.”

hunks.baseline: “Hold on. The Silver Flash Spear Hero, sure—but wasn’t that old Taebaek Divine Elder a dark-path figure?”
hunks.sol: “Hold on. The Silver Flash Spear, sure—but wasn’t that old Taebaek Divine Elder a dark-path figure?”

hunks.baseline: “……I’m a dark-path figure, too.”
hunks.sol: “…I’m a dark-path figure, too.”

hunks.baseline: The leaders of the most renowned orthodox sects. Great Heroes who had roamed the realm alone. Even reclusive masters who had supposedly died long ago.
hunks.sol: Leaders of renowned sects. Great Heroes who had roamed the realm alone. Even reclusive masters who had supposedly died long ago.

hunks.baseline: The orthodox martial artists weren’t the only ones unable to hide their excitement. Even the dark-path martial artists, who reached for their weapons at the slightest provocation, felt it this time.
hunks.sol: The orthodox martial artists weren’t the only ones unable to hide their excitement. Even dark-path martial artists, who reached for their weapons at the slightest provocation, felt it this time.

hunks.baseline: They had already fought alongside the legends known as the Three Saints, but wasn’t this the true unification of the realm?
hunks.sol: They had already fought alongside the legends known as the Three Saints, but wasn’t this true unity?

hunks.baseline: Even during the terrible Great Faction War, the power of the entire Murim had never gathered in one place with such unity.
hunks.sol: Even during the terrible Great Faction War, the forces of the entire Murim had never come together in one place like this.

hunks.baseline: And just like the martial artists, the government troops and commoners couldn’t hide their trembling excitement, each for their own reasons.
hunks.sol: The government troops and commoners were trembling with excitement, too, each for their own reasons.

hunks.baseline: The sudden sense that the air around them had crackled wasn’t the delusion of just one person.
hunks.sol: The sudden sense that the air around them had crackled wasn’t one person’s imagination.

hunks.baseline: They all wondered for a moment if they’d shared a collective hallucination. Then, as they looked at one another with wide eyes, they understood.
hunks.sol: For a moment, they all wondered if they’d heard the same thing wrong. Then they looked at one another’s wide eyes and understood.

hunks.baseline: He would enfeoff that young man, not a single drop of whose blood was noble dragon’s blood, as a prince.
hunks.sol: He would make that young man, with not a single drop of noble dragon’s blood in his veins, a king.

hunks.baseline: A king with a different surname, gone from history for hundreds of years, had just been born anew right here.
hunks.sol: A king of another surname, a title lost to history for hundreds of years, had just been created anew right here.

hunks.baseline: “Since you’re handing them out anyway, could you give me a few more royal titles while you’re at it?”
hunks.sol: “Since you’re handing them out anyway, could you go big and give me a few more royal titles?”

hunks.baseline: Afterward, people had to keep asking themselves, over and over, to remember what Jin Taekyung was like.
hunks.sol: Afterward, people had to keep asking themselves, and reminding themselves, what they knew about the man named Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: They’d heard rumors about him here and there.
hunks.sol: What had they heard in all those rumors about him?

hunks.baseline: Before long, they were able to confirm them with their own eyes and ears.
hunks.sol: Before long, they were able to confirm it with their own eyes and ears.

hunks.baseline: At Jin Taekyung’s shameless request for another royal title—as if he were asking for extra broth with his noodles—everyone held their breath.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was wheedling another royal title out of the Emperor as if he were asking for extra broth with his noodles. Everyone held their breath.

hunks.baseline: Some even thought the Son of Heaven, known for his iron-blooded rule, would punish Jin Taekyung on the spot.
hunks.sol: Some even thought the Son of Heaven, known for being iron-blooded, would punish Jin Taekyung on the spot.

hunks.baseline: That is, for a very brief moment.
hunks.sol: For a very brief moment.

hunks.baseline: “Thank you, Your Maj—oh.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you—hm.”

hunks.baseline: ……Seriously, what was going on?
hunks.sol: …Seriously, what was going on?

hunks.baseline: The people who’d watched every moment of this exchange were half out of their minds.
hunks.sol: Everyone who’d watched the whole exchange was half out of their minds.

hunks.baseline: Even after the Son of Heaven had traded a few more laughs with Jin Taekyung and headed toward the Inner City with the Imperial Guards, the shock they felt didn’t fade easily.
hunks.sol: Even after the Son of Heaven had traded a few more words and laughs with Jin Taekyung and headed toward the Inner City with the Imperial Guards, the shock didn’t fade.

hunks.baseline: No—instead, a different kind of shock was waiting for them.
hunks.sol: Instead, a different kind of shock awaited them.

hunks.baseline: A flood of men and horses poured through the wide-open city gates, followed by countless banners bearing the emblems of the great sects.
hunks.sol: A flood of men and horses poured through the wide-open city gates beneath countless banners bearing the emblems of the great sects.

hunks.baseline: The people who saw the figures emerging with extraordinary auras and gleaming eyes let out cries of amazement. Then a familiar feeling struck them.
hunks.sol: At the sight of the figures emerging with imposing auras and gleaming eyes, the people cried out in amazement. Then a familiar feeling struck them.

hunks.baseline: And with it, the same shock as before.
hunks.sol: Along with the same shock as before.

hunks.baseline: As if they’d planned it, they gathered around Jin Taekyung. He greeted the towering figures of the realm’s Murim as casually as if nothing were out of the ordinary.
hunks.sol: As if they’d planned it, they gathered around Jin Taekyung. He greeted the towering figures of the realm’s Murim as if there were nothing unusual about it.

hunks.baseline: “How could I forget Master Unnamed? But you’ve gotten even more muscular since I last saw you…… Wow.”
hunks.sol: “How could I forget Master Unnamed? But you’ve gotten even more muscular since I last saw you… Wow.”

hunks.baseline: Unnamed, the sole Disciple of Dharma King Hong Dao, and the man who had sworn not to take the seat of Abbot of Shaolin until Dark Heaven was rooted out.
hunks.sol: Unnamed, the sole Disciple left behind by Dharma King Hong Dao, who had sworn not to take the seat of Abbot of Shaolin until Dark Heaven was rooted out.

hunks.baseline: The Heavenly Sword True Person, who was the Sect Leader of Huashan first and foremost, not merely Sword Saint Mae Jonghak’s Disciple.
hunks.sol: The Heavenly Sword True Person, Sect Leader of Huashan in his own right, quite apart from being Sword Saint Mae Jonghak’s Disciple.

hunks.baseline: “We owe you a great debt for what happened in Sichuan. If it hadn’t been for you……”
hunks.sol: “We owe you a great debt for what happened in Sichuan. If it hadn’t been for you…”

hunks.baseline: Other Sect Leaders, Family Heads, and heads of sects.
hunks.sol: Other sect and family heads.

hunks.baseline: Surrounded by the leaders of the great sects—including Emei, Wudang, and the Beggars’ Sect—Jin Taekyung looked like a sight straight out of a hallucination.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung stood surrounded by the leaders of the great sects—including Emei, Wudang, and the Beggars’ Sect. It was enough to make people doubt their eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. I thought they’d come to Sichuan, too… But I was held up by those bastards. Even feeding them to that tiger wouldn’t have satisfied me. I have no excuse.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. I thought they’d come to Sichuan, too… But I was held up by those bastards. Throwing them to that tiger wouldn’t be enough. I have no excuse.”

hunks.baseline: As if he were a criminal.
hunks.sol: As if he were guilty of something.

hunks.baseline: “……Was he really this important?”
hunks.sol: “…Was he really that important?”

hunks.baseline: At the muttered words that slipped from someone’s lips, those who had watched the whole scene felt a shiver they couldn’t explain.
hunks.sol: At the words someone muttered, those who had watched the whole scene felt a shiver they couldn’t explain.

hunks.baseline: They were titans who represented the Murim beyond their own provinces, across the entire realm.
hunks.sol: Titans who represented not just their own provinces, but the Murim of the entire realm.

hunks.baseline: Even if Jin Taekyung was the Fire King’s Disciple, there should have been a world of difference between him and those people, given the gulf in age and the forces under their command.
hunks.sol: Even if Jin Taekyung was the Fire King’s Disciple, the gulf between him and those people should have been vast—in age and in the forces they commanded.

hunks.baseline: Or, more accurately, they saw and felt the truth they’d only vaguely suspected until now.
hunks.sol: Or rather, they saw and felt what they’d only vaguely suspected until now.

hunks.baseline: Just how much influence Jin Taekyung held in this world.
hunks.sol: Just how great Jin Taekyung’s standing was in this world.

hunks.baseline: And, at the same time, they suddenly sensed it.
hunks.sol: And at the same time, they suddenly sensed something else.

hunks.baseline: “Please have a drink with me! I’ll treasure it as the honor of a lifetime!”
hunks.sol: “Please accept a drink from me! I’ll count it the honor of a lifetime!”

hunks.baseline: “I think I’ve heard that about fifty times already…… But sure, pour me one.”
hunks.sol: “I think I’ve heard that about fifty times already… But sure, hand it over.”

hunks.baseline: With joy overflowing everywhere, it was only natural that the wine would overflow, too.
hunks.sol: With joy overflowing everywhere, maybe it was only natural that the cups overflowed, too.

hunks.baseline: I’d clasped hands in salute hundreds of times and received dozens of drinks.
hunks.sol: I’d clasped hands in salute hundreds of times and accepted dozens of drinks.

hunks.baseline: “Mother, our youngest is a king now. Sniff, sob.”
hunks.sol: “Mother, our youngest is a kiiiing now. Sniff, sob.”

hunks.baseline: “Long live the Emperor! I’ll cross the desert right now and smash those rebels’ heads in……!”
hunks.sol: “Long live the Emperor! I’ll cross the desert right now and smash those rebels’ heads in…!”

hunks.baseline: This is a mess.
hunks.sol: My head was spinning.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung had dropped the stern-and-serious act and started crying as soon as he got drunk. The Earth Mother Goddess’s fanatics—who by now practically regarded her as Nanman’s One God—were shouting their slogans.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung had dropped his stern-and-serious act and started crying as soon as he got drunk. The Earth Mother Goddess’s fanatics—by now, she was practically Nanman’s One God—were shouting their slogans.

hunks.baseline: I left the cries of Great Ming’s subjects, all fired up with loyalty, behind me and walked off alone.
hunks.sol: Leaving behind the cries of Great Ming’s subjects, all fired up with loyalty, I walked off alone.

hunks.baseline: Until all that noise had faded away.
hunks.sol: I kept going until all the noise had faded away.

hunks.baseline: Past the East Gate, as far as the river beyond the reach of Xining City’s lights, which filled every street.
hunks.sol: Past the East Gate, to the river beyond the reach of Xining City’s lights, which filled every street.

hunks.baseline: No—I’d deliberately avoided seeking her out to sort through the thoughts tangling around in my head.
hunks.sol: No—someone I’d deliberately avoided seeking out while I sorted through the thoughts tangled in my head.

hunks.baseline: My foot pressed slowly into the wet sand, leaving a soft depression.
hunks.sol: Wet sand gave softly beneath my slow step.

hunks.baseline: Standing beside the Bow Saint, I watched the rippling river in silence.
hunks.sol: Standing beside the Bow Saint, I watched the rolling river in silence.
